📋 Equity Final Sheet
ℹ How the Equity Model Works
80:20 Financing Structure — Each truck head (tractor) was purchased with 80% from the bank and 20% from the Director.
Director's Equity — The Director's 20% contribution is treated as an equity stake. The truck repays this from its net profit over the loan term. Equity balance reduces as payments are made.
Body Contribution — Each truck body was fully financed by the Director at ₦17,000,000. The truck repays ₦472,222/month on the 25th for 36 months.
Net Equity Position — Calculated as: Total Contributed − Total Repaid. A positive balance means the truck still owes the Director; zero means fully settled.
Manual Adjustments — Use the Adjustment column below to record any off-schedule corrections (e.g., lump-sum payments, waivers, corrections). All adjustments are logged in the audit trail.

🏦 Fleet Bank Loan Setup — Access Bank

Sets up the single fleet-wide bank loan. Total principal = all trucks' 80% contributions combined. Interest: 25% p.a. reducing balance. Monthly EMI split proportionally — trucks with higher purchase prices pay more. Due 24th of each month.
When adding a new truck: set up its finance first via ⚙️ Setup Truck Finance, then re-run this to recalculate with the new truck included.

🛡 Insurance Settings

How Insurance Works: Each truck carries an insurance obligation. The amount is deducted once from the truck's ledger. Once marked "Consumed", it will not carry forward until you record a new insurance payment for that truck.
This applies the same insurance value to ALL trucks and resets them to Active.

❓ How to Use This System

✅ DAILY USE
1. Save this HTML file to your Desktop or USB drive
2. Double-click to open in Chrome, Firefox or Edge — no internet needed
3. Enter trips daily under each truck tab
4. Totals, cumulative income, insurance balance all calculate automatically
5. Click 💾 Backup every day to download a safe .json copy
⚠️ DATA SAFETY
• Backup daily — store .json files in Google Drive, USB or email to yourself
• Do NOT clear browser data — it will erase auto-saved records
• Use 📂 Restore to reload any previous backup file
• Always use the same browser on the same computer
☁️ CLOUD SYNC — USE ON PHONE & PC
Click ☁️ Cloud in the nav bar → First Time Setup → follow 5 steps (free Google Firebase).
On your phone: open same HTML file → ☁️ Cloud → "Connect Existing" → enter same Fleet Code + PIN.
All devices now share data live. Changes appear on other devices within 2 seconds.
📊 INSURANCE — REDUCING BALANCE
Each truck carries a fixed ₦6,000,000 insurance obligation.
Every trip's income is applied against this balance (reducing method) until fully cleared.
The remaining balance shows in each trip row and updates automatically.

✅ WORKS ON PHONE, PC & TABLET — SAME DATA EVERYWHERE
Save this HTML file to your device → open in any browser → no internet needed for basic use.

⚠️ FIRST TIME? START HERE
1. Enter your company name below
2. Click ☁️ Cloud in the top menu → follow the 5-step setup (takes 5 minutes, free)
3. On your phone — open same file → click ☁️ Cloud → "Connect Existing" → enter same codes
4. Both devices now share all data in real-time!

☁️ Cloud Sync Setup

1 Create a Free Firebase Project

Go to console.firebase.google.com and sign in with your Google account.

Click "Add project" → Enter a name (e.g. samjones-haulage) → Click Continue → Disable Google Analytics → Click "Create project".

2 Create a Realtime Database

In your project, click "Build" in the left menu → "Realtime Database" → "Create Database".

Choose your region (e.g. us-central1) → Select "Start in test mode" → Click Enable.

3 Get Your Config Keys

Click the ⚙️ gear icon (top left) → "Project settings" → scroll down to "Your apps".

Click the </> Web icon → Enter an app name → Click "Register app".

You will see a config block like this — copy the values into the fields below:

apiKey: "AIzaSy..."
authDomain: "your-project.firebaseapp.com"
databaseURL: "https://your-project-default-rtdb.firebaseio.com"
projectId: "your-project-id"
4 Enter Your Firebase Config
5 Set Your Fleet Access Code

This is your unique code + PIN. Anyone with the same code and PIN on any device will share the same data. Keep it private!

🔗 Connect Another Device to Same Database
Enter the exact same Firebase config and Fleet Code + PIN used on the first device. All your data will appear automatically.
Firebase Config

🌐 Host on GitHub Pages — Share via a Link

GitHub Pages is free forever. It gives your app a permanent link like
https://yourname.github.io/sunfleetpro
Anyone with the link can open it on any phone or PC and install it as an app.
1 Create a Free GitHub Account

Go to github.com → Click "Sign up" → enter your email, password, username → Verify your account.

2 Create a New Repository

After signing in, click the + icon (top right) → "New repository".

Name it: sunfleetpro  → Set to Public → Tick "Add a README file" → Click "Create repository".

3 Upload Your HTML File

In your new repository, click "Add file" → "Upload files".

Drag your SunFleetPro_v70.html file into the upload box.

⚠ IMPORTANT: Before clicking commit, rename the file to index.html by clicking the filename field at the top and changing it.

Click "Commit changes" (green button at bottom).

4 Enable GitHub Pages

Go to your repository → Click "Settings" tab → In the left menu click "Pages".

Under "Branch", select main from the dropdown → Click "Save".

Wait 1–2 minutes. Refresh the page and you'll see your URL:

https://your-username.github.io/sunfleetpro
🚀 Launch Your App

Your saved link — tap to open it any time, no need to come back to this guide.

🚀 Open My App Now
📌 Save Your Link Here

Paste your live GitHub Pages URL from Step 4 above, so you can launch it from inside this app any time — no need to memorize or re-type it.

5 Share the Link

Send this link to anyone — via WhatsApp, SMS, or email. They open it in Chrome → the green install banner appears → tap Install → it appears on their home screen as an app.

✅ Everyone uses the same URL. When you update the file on GitHub, everyone gets the latest version automatically.

6 Connect All Users to One Database

After everyone installs from the link, each person needs to connect to the same Firebase database:

Tap ☁️ Cloud Sync in the app → Click "Connect Existing" tab → Enter the same Fleet Code and PIN you used on the first device → Click Connect. Done — all users now share one live database.

SunFleet Pro v31w · Suntech-Global Resources Ltd
💾 1. Keep Your Data Safe

⚠️ Important: Your SAMJONES data (24 trucks, FRO accounts, all trips) lives ONLY in this browser's storage. Clearing browser history or switching devices will erase it. Download a backup at least weekly.

📲 2. Install on This Device
Chrome / Edge (Windows, Android):
  1. Click the ⊕ Install icon in the address bar (right side)
  2. Click "Install" in the popup
  3. SunFleet Pro opens as a standalone app with its own window and taskbar icon
iPhone / iPad (Safari):
  1. Tap the Share button (box with arrow)
  2. Scroll down and tap "Add to Home Screen"
  3. Tap Add
Any browser (Alternative):
  1. Right-click the app tab → Create Shortcut
  2. Or drag the tab to your desktop
💻 3. Transfer to Another Computer / Phone
Step-by-step:
1 On this device: Click "Download Backup" above — saves a .json file
2 Transfer the app file: Send SunFleetPro_v19.html via WhatsApp, email, or USB to the new device
3 On new device: Open the HTML file in Chrome/Edge, log in
4 Restore data: Click "Restore Backup" and select your .json backup file — all data loads instantly
